title: Coherent shifts cannot lower the square-completed Wick energy below the free vacuum scale

coherent_boundary.q_space_trial: In real standard Gaussian coordinates xi_j with field covariance weights lambda_j=(2 omega_j)^(-1), the normalized coherent trial is psi_alpha=exp(sum_j alpha_j xi_j/2-sum_j alpha_j^2/4), so |psi_alpha|^2 dmu is N(alpha,I)
coherent_boundary.field_mean: The shifted field has arbitrary cutoff Cameron-Martin mean h(x)=sum_j sqrt(lambda_j) alpha_j e_j(x) and unchanged point variance C_N
coherent_boundary.wick_expectation: Pointwise Gaussian fourth moments give int E_alpha[(phi_N^2-3C_N)^2]dx=6C_N^2+int h(x)^4 dx on normalized T3
coherent_boundary.coherent_infimum: Therefore every coherent Rayleigh quotient is at least 6gC_N^2, and the vacuum alpha=0 attains exactly 6gC_N^2
coherent_boundary.scale: Since C_N=Theta(N^2), the coherent-sector variational bottom is exactly 6gC_N^2=Theta(N^4) for fixed g>0
coherent_boundary.scope_guard: This concerns covariance-preserving coherent shifts only; covariance squeezing, off-diagonal Gaussian covariance and genuinely non-Gaussian states are not classified
